name: Brady & Morris Engineering Company Limited
about: Brady & Morris Engineering Company Limited manufactures and sells cranes and material handling equipment in India. It offers single and double grinder, underslung, jib, gantry, and flameproof cranes; textile machinery and stores; and rope master and flameproof electric wire ropes, and electric chain hoists. The company also provides manual hoists, including RS chain pulley blocks, NX chain pulley blocks, ES chain pulley blocks, non-sparking chain pulley blocks, geared travelling trolleys, and non-sparking geared travelling trolleys. In addition, it offers various services, such as crane refurbishment, erection and commissioning, and service and repair. The company serves customers in steel, cement, power, sugar, chemicals, paper, mining, water and sewerage treatment, and defense industries. It distributes its products through a network of dealers and distributors. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is based in New Delhi, India. Brady & Morris Engineering Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of W. H. Brady & Company Limited.
